Bold clean dark navy outlines 5px, three-tone cel shading, compact almond cartoon eyes with dark pupils, expressive brows, carefully distinct recognizable jaw/ears/skin tones/beards. Modest three-quarter view facing viewer slightly left, almost frontal. HEAD ONLY hair top to chin, no neck, no torso, no hats or insignia. EXACT TWO columns TWO rows regular grid on square canvas about1024x1024, one isolated head centered per 512x512 cell, complete silhouette fromx70to440,y60to450 relative to cell, all chins baseline, generous transparent gutters. Keep individual likeness and characteristic features, head sizes comparable, do not repeat the same face. Fully transparent background and spaces. No text, labels, marks, logos or bounding boxes.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite sheet: FOUR original HEADLESS baseball player BODIES, isolated on truly transparent background, arranged exact TWO columns TWO rows with spacious transparent gutters. 1280x1280 square canvas. Every pose must fit entirely in its own640x640 cell, no overlap or touching cell edges. IMPORTANT headless modular body from collar to cleats, no head, no face, NO exposed neck, collar has a small dark recessed opening at the top to attach a large separate cartoon head. One coherent compact heroic CHIBI body design for a 2010s Flash baseball arcade/RPG: broad angular shoulders, short stocky torso, compact legs, oversized sculpted high-top cleats, large white batting gloves, bold navy black ink outlines, rich three-tone cel shading and glossy edge highlights, sophisticated illustrated sprite not simple vector shapes and not photorealistic. Original uniform navy short sleeves and navy shoulders, ivory central button-front jersey, angular teal piping, warm gold belt buckle, charcoal undershirt and navy knee socks, ivory tapered pants; no text, no logos, no numbers. White gloves completely cover hands to work with many skin tones. Modest three-quarter front view. Cell order row-major: 1 standing roster pose, feet apart, both gloved fists on hips, collar centered approximatelyx320 y100, boots bottomy580. 2 batting ready stance with both white gloved hands holding a charcoal and gold baseball bat behind right shoulder, legs bent; collar approximatelyx320 y130, boots bottomy580. 3 strong finished swing pose with bat held forward across chest, feet planted, torso twisted a little, collar approximatelyx320 y130, boots bottomy580. 4 victory pose with both gloved fists raised at shoulder height (NOT over head area), bat absent, collar approximatelyx320 y100, boots bottomy580. All four are same character's uniform and anatomy, no head drawn in any cell. No baseball, no floor shadow, no extra clothing objects, no labels, no bounding boxes, no backgrounds. A polished retro cartoon sprite design with intentional dimensional folds and edges.
